# Which music distributor leaves you the most?

> Free calculator comparing what an independent artist keeps on DistroKid, TuneCore, CD Baby, Amuse, RouteNote and UnitedMasters at their own release count and stream volume, with the streams-per-month crossover where the cheapest distributor changes. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
